en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Mhammad Bin Hilal, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The first matter to be manifested by Al-Qaimasws, from the justice, is that hisasws caller would be calling out: ‘The performer of the optional (Tawaaf) should make way for the performer of the Obligatory (Tawaaf), to the Black Stone and the Tawaaf’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya and others have narrated from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the first instance of justice that will be practiced after the reappearance of al-Qa’im, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, is that an announcer will announce this, ‘Those who perform optional al-Hajj must give a chance to those performing obligatory al-Hajj to reach the Black Stone.”’
